overview_tile.history_one_period: This project has one monitoring period. Add a second one and its trend is charted here.
overview_tile.timing_note: By the week an alert was first detected. Greyed weeks are look-back: they fall before this period started.
overview_tile.drivers_note: Reviewed alerts only ({reviewed} of {total}). An alert that names two causes is counted under each, so the bars can add up to more than the reviewed total.
overview_tile.drivers_empty: No alert has been reviewed yet, so no cause is on record.
overview_tile.admin_note: Reviewed alerts only ({reviewed} of {total}): the area is recorded when an alert is reviewed.
overview_tile.admin_empty: No alert has been reviewed yet, so no administrative area is on record.
overview_tile.chart_failed: This figure could not be drawn; its numbers are below.
overview_tile.read_failed: This set's alerts could not be read: {error}
overview_tile.no_set: No alert set yet. Run Integrate & vectorize to produce one.

timeline.lane_before: Before image lane. Use the left and right arrow keys to move along the dates and Enter to choose the image.
timeline.lane_after: After image lane. Use the left and right arrow keys to move along the dates and Enter to choose the image.
timeline.no_images: No images cover this alert in this window.
timeline.sources_off: The images in this window are all in collections you have switched off.
timeline.same_image: the same image on both sides
timeline.refresh_failed: Could not refresh the image index: {error}
timeline.image_failed_before: Could not draw the before image: {error}
timeline.image_failed_after: Could not draw the after image: {error}
timeline.legend: Each collection is a stripe in its own band: Sentinel-2 on top, Landsat in the middle, Planet as a bar across its month. A faded half-height stripe is over the cloud limit. The gold band is the alert window, where every image shows partial clearing: selectable, but never picked for you. Click a stripe in the upper lane to set the before image, in the lower lane to set the after image. Or put the focus on a lane and use the keyboard: the left and right arrow keys move along the dates, Home and End jump to the first and last image, and Enter chooses the one the ring is on.
timeline.no_cloud_filter: A NICFI basemap is a monthly mosaic with no cloud figure, so the cloud limit never hides it.

analysis_tile.description: Review each alert with before and after imagery, confirm it, set the loss driver, then save.
analysis_tile.info_md: Move between the alerts of the active set with the navigator; the set selector switches sets. The before and after maps show the closest cloud-free images: pick one of each. Draw or edit the deforested polygon, answer **Is this a true alert?**, choose the loss drivers, then **Save** writes the review into the set's alert store. **Download alert data** writes the alert's GeoPackage, its before/after images and a Word report built from the project's report template, chosen in the export card.

questionarie.confirmation_missing: Answer "Is this a true alert?" before saving.
questionarie.false_positive_drawn: A false positive cannot have a drawn deforestation polygon: delete the polygon or change the answer.

model_labels.dl_404: Model did not find forest loss polygons
model_labels.dl_step_run: Downloading images and running the model…
model_labels.dl_stale: The model finished after you moved to another alert: its prediction was not added.

export_labels.download_no_recipe: No alert set is active, so there is nowhere in the project to save the alert files. Run Integrate & vectorize first.
export_labels.download_no_alert: No alert is selected, so there is nothing to download.
export_labels.download_no_images: No before and after images are selected for this alert, so its files cannot be built. Pick a before and an after image first.
export_labels.save_no_alert: No alert is selected, so there is nothing to save.
export_labels.save_other_set: These alerts belong to another alert set than the active one, so they were not saved into it.
export_labels.save_set_changed: The active alert set changed while saving, so this review was not saved.
export_labels.save_store_changed: This alert set was rebuilt while you were reviewing it, so the alerts on screen are out of date and this review was not saved. Review the rebuilt alerts instead.
export_labels.report_template_hint: Every report of this project is built from this Word file. Leave it empty to use the app's default template.
export_labels.report_template_no_project: Open a project to choose its report template.
export_labels.report_template_bad: {path} is not a Word file (.docx) in your SEPAL folder; the report template was not changed.
export_labels.report_template_missing: The report template {path} is gone. Pick it again in the export card, or clear the field to use the default template.
